_note: Best-effort list of companies commonly known to use Greenhouse for public job boards. Board tokens can differ from the company name and change over time — ingest.py already skips any token that 404s, so it's safe to run as-is, but verify/expand this list yourself: visit a company's careers page and look for a URL like boards.greenhouse.io/<token> or job-boards.greenhouse.io/<token> to confirm the exact token.
